summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 title formatter and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True only when a terminal buffers the control; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Unverified: tests and mypy were not run, per instructions. Left _render_buffer unchanged, since it already emits the title sequence as text and drops control segments when not a terminal.
